name: GASToolsets.AttributeSetToolset
description: Provides tools for discovering AttributeSet classes and their gameplay attributes.

tools.description: Returns the gameplay attributes defined on a specific AttributeSet class.
tools.name: GASToolsets.AttributeSetToolset.ListAttributes

className.description: The UClass name to look up, e.g. "UMyHealthSet". Raises a script error if the class is not found or is not an AttributeSet subclass.

fullName.description: The fully-qualified attribute name including the set class (e.g. "UMyHealthSet.Health").

setClassName.description: The name of the AttributeSet class that owns this attribute (e.g. "UMyHealthSet").

returnValue.description: A list of attribute descriptors defined on the class.

tools.description:
Returns all AttributeSet subclasses found in the project, including their attributes.
Covers both native C++ subclasses and Blueprint subclasses discovered via the asset registry.
tools.name: GASToolsets.AttributeSetToolset.FindAttributeSetClasses

className.description: The UClass name of the attribute set (e.g. "UMyHealthSet").

assetPath.description: The object path to the Blueprint asset, or empty for native C++ classes.

fullName.description: The fully-qualified attribute name including the set class (e.g. "UMyHealthSet.Health").

setClassName.description: The name of the AttributeSet class that owns this attribute (e.g. "UMyHealthSet").

attributes.description: The gameplay attributes defined on this set.

returnValue.description: A list of attribute set descriptors sorted by class name.
